This '''mercenary''', a member of a [[Falcon's Nest mercenaries|group]] of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] operating from the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Falcon's Nest]], was part of an attack on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class]] heavy [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Tal'cara (Dreadnaught-class)|''Tal'cara'']], which was meeting with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']].
